summary: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) is now requiring all e-commerce food platforms and their suppliers to have food safety audits twice a year instead of once a year. If a partner doesn't pass these audits, the platform must stop doing business with them. This new rule replaces the older annual audit requirement.
impact: This means you'll need to make sure all your food suppliers and partners understand and comply with the new twice-a-year audit schedule. You'll need to check their audit reports more frequently and be prepared to stop working with any partner who fails an audit or doesn't provide proof on time. Your daily work involves ensuring compliance with these new standards.
benefits: This stricter rule helps ensure the food served through our platforms is consistently safe, protecting customers and maintaining public trust. It also encourages all partners to maintain higher hygiene and safety standards throughout the supply chain.
flash_alerts: Update your agreements with partners to reflect the new mandatory bi-annual audit requirement.
Schedule and ensure timely completion of the bi-annual independent audits for all key food suppliers and partners.
Keep meticulous records of all audit reports and be prepared to submit proof if required within 15 days.
Be prepared to suspend business with any partner who fails an audit or fails to provide the required bi-annual certificate.
